parameters.name: AutoCreateRepo
parameters.description: Specifies whether a repository is automatically created when an image is pushed to a repository that does not yet exist in the namespace.

parameters.name: DefaultRepoType
parameters.description:
The default type of automatically created repositories. Valid values:

- `PUBLIC`: public

- `PRIVATE`: private

parameters.name: NamespaceName
parameters.description: The name of the namespace. The name must be 2 to 120 characters long and can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and the following separators: underscores (\_), hyphens (-), and periods (.). A separator cannot be used as the first or last character.
